preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
The number of rows n and columns m must be between 1 and 200000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i][j] <= 10**9 for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: Each element in the grid must be a positive integer between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(stdout.split()) == 2 and 1 <= int(stdout.split()[0]) <= m and 1 <= int(stdout.split()[1]) <= m)
postconditions.description: The output must either be -1 or two valid column indices.

postconditions.expression: any(all(a[i][j] >= a[i][j-1] for j in range(1, m)) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: After the swap, the grid must be good, meaning each row must be sorted in non-decreasing order.
